questions.stemHtml: A 6 year old boy presents with ear pain, and hearing loss for the past 2 days. He also has a recent history of the common cold. Otoscopy shows a retracted tympanic membrane with fluid. What is the most likely cause of his condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Increased secretory activity of the middle ear mucosa

options.label: C
options.text: Biofilm formation in the middle ear
